verdict.rationale: Close ships a built-in AI agent, Chloe, on every plan and usable in Workflows. Chloe qualifies prospects through conversations and updates the CRM automatically, which yields AI-generated assessments of leads inside the product. That is only a glancing fit for in-product insights and suggestions drawn from the user's data. The MCP server only gives external AI tools access to Close data, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI insights or recommendations over CRM data (e.g. deal/pipeline suggestions, summaries, next-best-action), detail on what Chloe's 'AI leverage' surfaces to users, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
